question: Can one strict render recipe, its exact profile, and its exact profile assets be exported as a deterministic, create-only recovery bundle without including input or output pixels?

decision.pass: retain private no-pixel deterministic recipe recovery bundle boundary
decision.fail: close this bundle format without weakening recipe, hash, path or privacy checks
